title: Essential Bengali Nouns
summary: Common nouns for people, places, objects, and everyday life.

phrases.en: That person is very kind.
Rahim is my friend.
My family lives in Dhaka.
Our house is small.
School starts at eight in the morning.
This is my favorite book.
Please give me water.
The food is on the table.
Today is a beautiful day.
I do not have time now.
This road goes to the station.
This city is very large.
The room's door is open.
Light is coming through the window.
The key is on the table.
My phone is in the bag.
The computer is very fast.
The table is beside the window.
The chair is in front of the table.
It is ten o'clock on the clock.
My bag is blue.
I bought a pen.
Put the paper on the table.
The child is sleeping.
The teacher is teaching in class.
The student is reading a book.
The doctor is at the hospital.
The market is closed today.
The shop opens at nine in the morning.
The hospital is near the city.
The bus is standing at the station.
The train comes in the morning.
The car is in front of the house.
The cat is under the chair.
The dog is playing in the garden.
There is a bird in the tree.
There is a big tree in the garden.
This flower is very beautiful.
The sun can be seen in the sky today.
The moon is very bright at night.
Say: “That person is very kind.”
Say: “Rahim is my friend.”
Say: “My family lives in Dhaka.”
Say: “Our house is small.”
